jobs.title: Senior Front End Developer
jobs.description:
IMMEDIATE OPENING – SENIOR FRONTEND DEVELOPER (REACT / NEXT.JS)

Location: Hyderabad  
Experience: 5\+ Years  
Salary: Up to ₹10 LPA  
Joining: Immediate Joiners Only

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to lead the design and development of scalable, high\-performance web applications using React and Next.js. You will own architecture decisions, mentor junior engineers, and drive best practices across the frontend codebase. This role also requires comfort using AI\-assisted development tools and evaluating AI\-generated output for quality, security, and performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Architect, build, and maintain scalable, production\-grade applications using React and Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG, ISR).
* Lead technical design discussions and make architecture decisions for component structure, state management, and data flow.
* Own performance optimization — Core Web Vitals, bundle size, rendering strategy (CSR vs. SSR vs. SSG), and caching.
* Review pull requests with a focus on code quality, scalability, accessibility, and maintainability — including code generated with AI tools.
* Use AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to accelerate development, while critically reviewing generated code for correctness, security, and adherence to standards.
* Collaborate with backend engineers to define and consume REST/GraphQL APIs, including error handling and loading states.
* Translate Figma/design system files into reusable, accessible, well\-tested components.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Drive adoption of testing strategy (unit, integration, E2E) using tools like Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Partner with product managers and designers to scope features, estimate effort, and identify technical tradeoffs.
* Stay current with the React/Next.js ecosystem and evaluate new tools, libraries, and AI\-assisted workflows for team adoption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* 5\+ years of professional frontend development experience.
* Expert\-level proficiency in JavaScript (ES6\+) and TypeScript.
* Deep, hands\-on experience with React (Hooks, Context API, component design patterns) and Next.js (App Router/Pages Router, SSR, SSG, ISR, API routes).
* Strong understanding of state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query, or similar).
* Solid grasp of HTML5, CSS3, responsive design, and CSS frameworks/tools (Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, or CSS Modules).
* Proven experience optimizing web performance and Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP).
* Experience with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL, including authentication (JWT, OAuth).
* Practical, hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) in a real development workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and validate AI\-generated code.
* Strong testing background (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress, or Playwright).
* Proficiency with Git and collaborative workflows (GitHub/GitLab, code reviews, CI/CD).
* Experience with web accessibility standards (WCAG/ARIA).
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Exposure to backend/full\-stack development (Node.js) for closer collaboration on API design.
* Experience integrating AI/LLM features into frontend applications (e.g., chat interfaces, streaming responses, prompt\-driven UI).
* Experience with cloud/deployment platforms (Vercel, AWS, Azure).
* Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading a small team.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

SOFT SKILLS

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to work independently on ambiguous problems.
* Product\-oriented thinking — considers the end user, not just the ticket.
* Effective mentor and communicator, comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback.
* Comfortable pushing back on design or product decisions with data\-backed reasoning.

SALARY AND JOINING

Salary: Up to ₹10 LPA  
Location: Hyderabad  
Joining: Immediate Joiners Only

HOW TO APPLY

Interested candidates can share their CV at jegan@mullytech.in

Email Subject:  
Senior Frontend Developer – React/Next.js \| Notice Period \| Current CTC

Please include your Notice Period and Current CTC along with your CV.

Only Immediate Joiners are requested to apply.

\#Hiring \#ImmediateJoiner \#ReactJS \#NextJS \#FrontendDeveloper \#SeniorFrontendDeveloper \#JavaScript \#TypeScript \#HyderabadJobs \#ITJobs \#TechJobs \#HiringNow \#IndiaJobs

Pay: ₹600,000\.00 \- ₹1,000,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Are you available to join immediately within 7 days notice ?
* Current CTC
* Expected CTC

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana (Hyderabad, Hyderabad District)

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Business Platforms, Sales and Support
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in product management or related technical role.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 10 years of experience with enterprise product management.
* Experience working in a cross\-functional organization and influencing engineers, product managers, or senior executives.
* Engineering or technical experience shipping technical products.
* Strong product management, business acumen, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem\-solving, data analysis skills and articulate business judgment.

**About the job**
-----------------


At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  

  

In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.  

  

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

  


In this role, you will bring the experience, passion, and drive to envision and deliver great user experiences, great platform services, and meaningful impact to customers' businesses. As a part of this role, you will help radically transform what users expect of a contact center through agentic capabilities, insights, ML\-based automation, and platform capabilities. As a part of this role, you will need to go past the obvious, be unafraid to hold an opinion on strategy and direction, and bring the tenacity and conviction to turn into reality. In this role, you will need to be a learner, curious, and articulate someone who is aspirational, bold, and transformative, yet practical and impact focused.


The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Understand users and problem domains, articulate business goals, and define crisp execution plans, including product strategy, and roadmap that is detailed, clear, and compelling to users, and clearly defined for our team.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, UX, Program Managers, and other teams to deliver a product that we and our users are proud of and that meets our business or technical goals.
* Earn the trust of our team, of our leaders, and our users, by delivering on our commitments and getting things done.
* Craft new opportunities proactively to improve the lives of our users, and work across the organization to pursue them.
* Maintain a level of curiosity and hunger to learn as the AI technological shifts continue, staying comfortable with change, flexible and adaptable in technical, organizational, and customer shifts.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Associate Workspace
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through a large and diverse global workforce. The experience our Customer Service Associates have at work directly affects their ability to successfully serve customers.  

  

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to reimagine the day\-to\-day experience of being a Customer Service Associate and define the future of our Associate Workspace.  

  

Our ambition is to make work simpler, more personalized, connected and engaging. Associates should have a coherent experience through which they can manage their workday, understand what matters to them, stay informed about changes, see their performance and progress, interact with their teams, and feel recognized for the work they do.  

  

Today, many of these experiences are fragmented across different tools, systems and communication channels. The opportunity is not simply to aggregate them into a single interface. It is to rethink the experience from first principles around what associates need to successfully navigate and engage with their work.  

  

Imagine an experience that understands each associate and their context and helps answer: What do I need to know today? What has changed? What actions do I need to take? How am I doing? What opportunities are available to me? How can I better connect with my team and organization?  

  

The opportunity also extends beyond simplifying work. We want to explore how recognition, community, interaction and thoughtfully designed engagement mechanisms can make work more motivating and connected. This could include new ways to celebrate progress and achievements, create team experiences, or use gamification to make appropriate aspects of work more engaging, while thoughtfully navigating privacy, regulatory and cultural considerations across our global workforce.  

  

As the Principal PM, you will define the long\-term product vision and strategy for this experience. You will determine how capabilities spanning work management, communications, performance visibility, recognition, engagement and personalization should come together into a coherent product.  

  

This is a highly ambiguous, zero\-to\-one role with significant cross\-organizational scope. Many underlying capabilities will continue to be owned by other teams. You will establish the product experience and architecture that brings them together, influence partner roadmaps, and align senior Product, Engineering, UX, Science and Operations leaders around a common direction.  

  

You will also define how AI and associate context can make the experience increasingly proactive and personalized, reducing friction and cognitive load while giving associates greater visibility and control over their work experience.  

  

The ideal candidate is a product leader who can move fluidly between customer insight, product strategy and technology. You should be comfortable identifying opportunities that are not yet well defined, creating clarity from ambiguity, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and translating a long\-term vision into incremental customer value.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As the Principal Product Manager for Associate Workspace, you will:  

* Define the long\-term vision, product strategy and roadmap for the day\-to\-day associate experience across Amazon Customer Service.
* Work directly with associates and Operations to identify the most important problems and opportunities to improve their experience at work.
* Define a coherent experience spanning areas such as work and schedule management, communications and change, performance and progress visibility, recognition, community, engagement and interaction.
* Develop new ways to make work more engaging, including recognition, team experiences and gamification, while partnering with Legal, HR and other teams to ensure experiences are appropriate for a diverse global workforce.
* Define how associate context and personalization should shape the information, actions and experiences surfaced to each associate.
* Establish product principles and architecture that allow capabilities owned by multiple organizations and systems to behave as a unified experience.
* Define how AI can simplify the associate experience, reduce cognitive load and make the Workspace increasingly proactive and personalized.
* Partner with senior Engineering and UX leaders to make product and technical choices that enable the long\-term vision while delivering value incrementally.
* Establish and influence cross\-organizational roadmaps, priorities and ownership boundaries required to deliver the experience.
* Define success measures that go beyond adoption to understand tool effectiveness, friction, cognitive load, effort, engagement and associate experience, and connect improvements where possible to operational and customer outcomes.
* Influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations and partner organizations to align around and deliver a common associate experience.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* 10\+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience owning technology products

As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
   

  

**AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**YOUR IMPACT**
 The Lead Product Manager is responsible for driving product execution and release delivery throughout the product development lifecycle. Working closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, and other cross\-functional stakeholders, you will translate strategic product objectives into actionable plans and successful product outcomes.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as the bridge between business priorities and technical execution, ensuring that customer needs, product strategy, and engineering investments are effectively aligned. You will lead requirement definition, prioritization, backlog management, and release planning activities while helping teams deliver high\-quality enterprise software solutions at scale.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring strong leadership, product ownership, Agile delivery expertise, and a passion for continuously improving product development processes within a global organization.
   

  

**What The Role Offers**
* Defining and managing the product roadmap, prioritizing features, and ensuring timely delivery.
* Conducting market research to understand customer needs, identify opportunities, and validate solutions.
* Collaborating with key customers (internal/external) to acquire and respond to product feedback for future product releases and communicate roadmap details.
* Understanding product competitors and supporting the development of competitive responses for sales and marketing.
* Independently managing products and ensuring alignment with other cross\-functional teams.
* Balancing customer needs with strategic priorities to define a roadmap that drives product success.
* Tracking and reporting on key product performance indicators (KPIs), analyzing data, and identifying areas for improvement.
* Managing buy/build/partner technology decisions.
* Reducing COGS by leveraging automation, building scalable systems, and utilizing elastic infrastructure to support dynamic product demands.
* Supporting architectural reviews, evaluating technical debts, and educating stakeholders on business outcomes for addressing the same.
* Contributing to defining and managing pricing and billing strategies.
* Collaborating with Product Marketing on executing successful product launches, including communication and marketing strategies.
* Championing the product to external partners and stakeholders.
* Wherever appropriate, deliver capabilities as APIs first and commercialize APIs


**What You Need To Succeed**
* 5\+ years of experience in product ownership/management roles and an overall experience of more than 10 years in IT
* Proficient in Agile methodology, writing user stories, and backlog grooming.
* Able to independently conduct user research.
* Strong understanding of SAP, SaaS architecture and cloud technologies
* Strong business and technical acumen with the ability to translate business objectives into product requirements and successful product outcomes
* Experience with enterprise\-grade content management systems is desired.
* Leadership skills with an ability to influence cross\-functional distributed global teams and drive alignment without direct authority
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Experience in OpenText Content Products is preferred
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Computer Science, ECE, or related field).
* Master’s degree in business administration (MBA) or equivalent (preferred focus in Product Management, Strategy, or Analytics).
* Knowledge of AI \& ML fundamentals


 OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
   

  

 If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us at hr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

jobs.description:
**Company Overview**
 Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee\-first, performance\-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category\-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
   

  

 Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short\-term and long\-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people\-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry\-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
   

  

**Job Overview**
**Senior Product Manager – Risk Platform**
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to help define and scale a modern risk and compliance platform for a global payments business. The platform will serve as the common foundation for embedding risk and compliance into payment journeys consistently, intelligently, and at scale.
   

  

 This is a platform product role: the successful candidate will think beyond individual workflows and design reusable services, APIs, and configuration models that can be adopted by multiple products and business lines. The role requires strong systems thinking, technical fluency, and the ability to balance regulatory obligations, operational efficiency, and user experience.
   

  

 What You’ll Do
   

  

* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for reusable risk and compliance platform capabilities across products and regions.
* Turn risk, compliance, operational, and customer needs into clear product requirements and delivery plans.
* Shape core platform capabilities such as policy evaluation, decision orchestration, restrictions, and verification journeys.
* Design capabilities that can be consumed through standardized APIs, hosted experiences, and embedded user flows.
* Build shared foundations such as canonical data models, action and decision models, and reusable workflow patterns.
* Partner with Engineering, Architecture, UX, and Compliance teams to deliver scalable and explainable solutions.
* Use data and stakeholder feedback to identify gaps, prioritize trade\-offs, and measure platform impact.
* Balance self\-service adoption with governance, reliability, and regulatory readiness.
* Communicate product direction, key decisions, and delivery progress to senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 5\+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in platform, fintech, payments, or regulated products.
* Experience with risk, compliance, KYC/KYB, or AML workflows.
* Experience with API\-first platforms, workflow orchestration, decisioning systems, or third\-party integrations.
* Strong track record defining strategy, building roadmaps, and driving cross\-functional execution.
* Platform mindset, with the ability to design reusable capabilities, APIs, workflows, and shared data models.
* Strong systems thinking, with the ability to simplify complex processes across products, systems, and teams.
* Good understanding of UX, workflows, business processes, and operational needs.
* Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, data models, and system design.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills across senior and cross\-functional audiences.
* Comfortable operating with ambiguity, structuring complex problems, and driving alignment across competing priorities.

jobs.title: AI Digital Product Sr Manager – AI Platforms
jobs.description:
**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
 At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are seeking an
 **AI Digital Product Sr Manager** 
 within Enterprise AI \& Data Science to lead the strategy, execution, and evolution of
 **Amgen's Enterprise AI Workbench** 
 . This developer\-centric platform enables AI engineers, software engineers, data scientists, and citizen builders to rapidly build, deploy, govern, and scale enterprise AI agents that accelerate scientific discovery, streamline R\&D workflows, and improve enterprise decision making.
   

  

 You will drive the product strategy for a secure, cloud\-native AI platform that provides reusable services, SDKs, APIs, orchestration, developer tooling, observability, and governance. Working cross\-functionally with engineering, platform architecture, Responsible AI, security, and business teams, you will deliver a world\-class developer experience while ensuring enterprise\-grade security, compliance, and Responsible AI.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead Product Ownership for Enterprise AI Platform: Act as the Product Manager within an Agile framework, ensuring that AI platform products meet the needs of customers and align with the organization's strategic goals. Drive the evolution of a reusable enterprise AI Workbench that includes AI project creation, project provisioning, AI gateway, computation enablement, observability \& evaluation, deployment services, and governance capabilities.
* Champion an exceptional developer experience and Platform Strategy by simplifying AI development through reusable SDKs, APIs, templates, documentation, reference implementations, self\-service capabilities, and internal developer tooling. Translate business needs into technical requirements and prioritize initiatives to increase impact.
* Scale Enterprise AI: Lead the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI initiatives from discovery through enterprise scale, identifying reusable platform capabilities that accelerate adoption while optimizing reliability, scalability, latency, and AI inference costs.
* Own platform health and adoption metrics including product usage, active builders, developer experience, platform adoption, model quality, reliability, latency, cost efficiency, Responsible AI compliance, and customer satisfaction.
* Drive Responsible AI and Quality: Establish governance, guardrails, evaluation standards, and policy enforcement in partnership with Responsible AI, Security, Privacy, Legal, and Enterprise Architecture. Define evaluation frameworks for quality, safety, reliability, latency, hallucination risk, cost, and business outcomes.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in leading products, defining roadmaps and tracking the success of the product.
* Strong technical fluency with cloud\-native software platforms and the ability to collaborate effectively with software engineers, AI engineers, platform engineers, architects, data scientists, and business stakeholders. Excellent critical thinking, problem solving, and communication skills,
* Overall 12\-17 Years of experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of product management or related experience, including 5\+ years delivering AI/ML, developer platform, cloud platform, or enterprise software products.
* Experience building or managing enterprise AI platforms, developer platforms, platform\-as\-a\-product, or shared platform capabilities that enable internal or external developers.
* Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agent orchestration, model serving, AI evaluation, and ML productization in enterprise environments.
* Experience with modern AI and cloud technologies such as AWS, Databricks, MLflow, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, AutoGen, N8N, or comparable AI development platforms and frameworks.
* Experience with cloud\-native architectures, APIs, SDKs, microservices, event\-driven systems, and modern software engineering practices, with the ability to partner effectively with engineering teams on technical architecture and product decisions.
* Experience defining and measuring developer experience, platform adoption, product analytics, customer success metrics, and platform health, using data to drive product decisions and prioritization.
* Experience establishing or partnering on Responsible AI, security, privacy, governance, and compliance practices for enterprise AI platforms, including guardrails, policy enforcement, and evaluation standards.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience presenting product strategy, technical vision, and business outcomes to senior leadership.
* Hands\-on experience using experimentation, telemetry, observability, and customer feedback to improve platform adoption, product quality, and user experience.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 This role leads the strategic vision and roadmap for a technical product or products within a specific business area, demonstrating a deep understanding of the product(s). Products may have enterprise\-wide implications. This role also uses market insights to evaluate product functionality and informs the future product direction based on consumer trends and product performance.
   

  

**Responsibilites**
* Leads technical product management activities for multiple technical products, or one strategic technical product. Participates in the design and continuous improvement of the technical solution.
* Collaborates with cross\-functional teams to create best practices that drive significant change to the client experience.
* Coaches technical product teams towards best practices and learnings. Ensures delivery of messaging, communication, and customer outreach as necessary.
* Partners with stakeholders to resolve production and implementation issues in a timely manner, and supports/drives escalations where required to enable rapid delivery.
* Leads the planning, development and implementation of new technical products. Defines and analyzes technical markets, developing detailed product features and requirements, and developing implementation plans.
* Employs a variety of qualitative and quantitative analysis techniques to continually improve the user experience.
* Participates in and provides recommendations for ongoing business planning and departmental prioritization activities.
* Participates in the team’s engineering practices in development, continuous integration, and automated deployment.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Manages the entire product life cycle from planning to execution in alignment with business goals and strategy.
* Researches and analyzes market conditions to identify key consumer trends and opportunities for product enhancements or innovation.
* Determines product features and functions by gathering business and customer feedback and translating it into product requirements.
* Prepares product documentation and supports go\-to\-market activities by providing product knowledge to sales and marketing teams.
* Leverages market and performance feedback to evaluate product effectiveness and steer future product direction.


**Qualifications And Skills**
* Minimum 8 years of experience in technical product management, with at least 2 years leading large cross\-functional teams. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field required; graduate degree preferred.
* Good to have skills in product lifecycle management, market analysis, product design, user experience evaluation, technical documentation, and cross\-functional stakeholder collaboration. Technical knowledge in software development processes, APIs, cloud platforms, or data\-driven product environments is important.
* Strong communication, strategic thinking, problem\-solving, and project execution skills.
* Preferred certifications include Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO), Pragmatic Institute Product Management Certifications, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM). Ability to balance technical feasibility with business viability and user desirability is essential.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
**Benefits**
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Technical Product Manager** 
 to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of our
 **B2C mobile products** 
 . The role requires strong
 **technical expertise, product management experience, and a deep understanding of mobile interfaces and user experience** 
 . You will connect customer and business needs with technology to deliver impactful, intuitive, and market\-ready digital products.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Own the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and demand funnel for B2C mobile products.
* Translate customer, market, and business needs into product features, user stories, technical enablers, and clear requirements.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog, balancing customer value, business objectives, market trends, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with Engineering/R\&D and UX/UI teams to deliver intuitive, scalable, and high\-quality mobile experiences.
* Lead the product journey from concept and requirements through realization, validation, and market delivery.
* Drive stakeholder alignment and roadmap governance, including demos, progress updates, risks, dependencies, and business outcomes.

 What you bring
   

  

**Experience**
* 10\+ years of overall professional experience, including at least 5 years of relevant experience in Product Management for B2C mobile applications/products.
* Strong technical acumen and ability to effectively collaborate with Engineering/R\&D teams on technical solutions, architecture, APIs, integrations, and dependencies.
* Strong understanding of mobile interfaces, UI/UX principles, navigation, interaction patterns, and mobile user journeys.
* Proven experience owning product strategy, roadmaps, backlog management, prioritization, and the end\-to\-end product lifecycle.
* Ability to translate customer and business needs into clear product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and software requirements.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with UX/UI, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Service, and Delivery teams.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills with a customer and outcome\-focused mindset.


***Personal competencies***
* Tech Savvy \& Product Mindset
* Customer Centric
* Strategic \& Visionary
* Strong Ownership \& Accountability
* Collaborative \& Influential
* Analytical \& Problem Solver
* Results Oriented \& Adaptable


 Who we are
   

  

 At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
   

  

 Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager for Revenue Cycle Management
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
 **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
 Technical Product Manager \- RCM (Revenue Cycle Management) Common Data Platform
   

  

 The Technical Product Manager (TPM) \- RCM Common Data Platform drives the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of building out a unified data platform across the full Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) lifecycle. The solution will ultimately ingest disparate EHR and healthcare data sources, standardize them and normalize them into single source of truth. This individual will work alongside members from across Optum to solve complex business needs for our internal operations teams. The role is key to execution on critical use cases to understand the data, ingest data, unify disparate data and drive AI powered insights. The ideal candidate for this role must be passionate about how we can leverage data to drive improvements in our RCM Operations, effective at working in a fast\-paced, high\-energy environment and confident in their interactions with senior leaders. The TPM RCM Common Data Platform role combines deep technical product expertise with solid RCM data knowledge to deliver scalable, compliant, AI powered insights that reduce administrative burden, improves performance, accelerates throughput, and strengthen financial outcomes.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
* Drive Product Strategy \& Product Execution for CDP Data
+ Leads the data strategy across one\-to\-multiple CDP workstreams including (but not limited to) Longitudinal Account Record, Ambulatory Insights and AI Powered RCM Insights
+ Leads product team members in translating desired capabilities into product requirements specifications and/or operational AI powered enhancements \- serving as the data expert to drive product and engineering to complete CDP build as outlined in projected roadmap
+ Understands the planned architecture of CDP, how it is being utilized to meet business/operational needs
+ Strategically aligns with Commercial team on Common Data Platform \- along with how the data will be utilized from the platform
+ Strategically aligns with teams infusing data into Common Data Platform \- along with how the data will be utilized from the platform

* Technical Product Leadership \& Architecture Alignment
+ Leads technical product design for CDP data, ensuring alignment with engineering and architecture standards
+ Partners with engineering to identify and drive improvements in data ingestion, labeling, interoperability, and integration across RCM ecosystem
+ Balances rapid delivery needs with scalable architecture and long‑term platform health

* Agile Execution \& Operational Excellence
+ Leads agile product practices across engineering and data architecture teams to ensure predictable, high‑quality delivery of new capabilities
+ Maintains a rigorous Definition of Done
+ Partners with delivery leadership to manage team capacity, predictability of sprints, and cross‑team dependencies for deployment

jobs.title: Product Manager — Intelligence & Internal Systems
jobs.description:
We're hiring:
 




  





 Product Manager — Intelligence \& Internal Systems —
 
 1acre.in
 
  






 Land is the most opaque market in India. People still get burned buying a plot because the basic information — is it verified, who owns it, what's the master plan, can I even reach the seller — is scattered or hidden.
 




  






 We're fixing that. 1acre is India's verified land \& plot marketplace: 16,000\+ verified lands and plots on one live map, real sellers you can contact directly, no spam. Mission is simple — solve the information problem in land. Verify it, make it instantly discoverable, help people transact at scale. Then take it global.
 




  






 Two things here are bottlenecked on people, not ideas. Our intelligence layers need to expand faster and hold higher quality. And our internal teams are managing deal flow without a system that fits how land actually gets sold. You own both — with AI as a force multiplier at every step.
 




  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**Data layers \& intelligence** 



* Sourcing, coverage, and quality of our map layers — survey numbers, master plans, metro, air funnels, cadastral, heritage.
* The full pipeline from raw government or survey data to a published, verified, correctly\-attributed layer, plus the state\-wise layer pages that go with it.
* Coverage and accuracy are your numbers. When a layer is wrong, it's yours to catch before a user does.
* This work directly feeds our organic search strategy — every well\-built layer page is a page that can rank. You'll work closely with the Senior PM on it.



  





**CRM \& internal deal\-flow systems** 



* Sales and ops teams currently manage buyer enquiries, seller onboarding, and verification without custom tooling.
* Choose, configure, and run the CRM, including land deal pipeline stages, lead routing, WhatsApp/call\-log integration, ownership rules, and reporting.
* Drive CRM adoption by observing team workflows directly and removing friction.



  





**Instrumentation \& reporting** 



* Define and maintain the Mixpanel event layer.
* Build the funnels and dashboards the team makes decisions on.
* Publish the weekly numbers, and be the person who notices something moved and says so before anyone asks.



  





**Quality, end to end** 



* Turn problems into specs crisp enough that both engineers and AI agents can build from them with zero guesswork.
* Partner with design (Figma) on flows, edge cases, empty and error states, and the copy that goes with them.
* Own the test plan. Verify on real devices. Confirm the analytics events actually fire. Sign off before anything launches.
* Content audits, competitor teardowns, support\-ticket patterns. Unglamorous, and the fastest way to learn where the product actually hurts.



  





  





**HOW WE WORK** 




**We ship, then we decide.** 

 Something small in front of real users in two weeks beats two months of research. Features get killed often and that's normal — the point is to learn fast, not to be right the first time.
 




  




* **Bias to action:** 

 When something is unclear, go find out. Don't wait for the answer to arrive in a meeting.
* **Clear ownership and tracking:** 

 Every launch carries a metric and a decision date before it goes out.
* **Radical transparency:** 

 When something you built isn't working, say so early. Nobody here is punished for that. Sitting on it is the actual mistake.



  





  





**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS** 




**Month 1** 

 — Learn the product cold: every filter, every layer, every listing flow. Sit with the verification and ops teams and follow a listing from submission to live. Get on 10 buyer and seller calls and write up what you heard.
 




  





**Month 2** 

 — Own your first layer end to end, from data sourcing to published page. Map the deal\-flow process as it actually runs, not as anyone says it runs.
 




  





**Month 3** 

 — CRM configured and used daily by the sales team. Weekly metrics report running without anyone asking for it.
 




  





  





  





**YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU** 




  




* Have ≈1–2 years of work experience. Your function matters less than your curiosity and your throughput — analyst, engineering, ops, growth, consulting, or PM all work.
* Are comfortable with data and unforgiving detail. Spreadsheets fluent, willing to learn SQL fast. Layer work punishes carelessness.
* Are genuinely AI\-native — you use LLMs every day to spec, prototype, clean data, test, and analyze, and you have real opinions about where they help.
* Write with precision. Short sentences, real conclusions, nothing ambiguous.
* Are organised enough to run a system other people depend on.
* Treat QA as your job, not someone else's — it's not "done" until you've tried to break it.
* Know (or will rapidly learn) the Indian land context — survey numbers, plots vs lands, cents/gaj, master plans, district\-level nuance.
* Will go to the field. Site visits, revenue offices, conversations with agents in their language.
* Take feedback well and act on it the same week.
* Sweat the details AND move fast. Both, not one.



  





**BONUS POINTS** 



* Any exposure to GIS, maps, QGIS, or government land records.
* Have set up or administered a CRM — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Kylas, LeadSquared, any of them.
* SQL, Python, or scripting to clean and reconcile messy datasets.
* Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, or Hindi for user and agent conversations.
* Hands\-on with Figma, Linear/Jira, Mixpanel/Google Analytics.
* A side project, teardown, or portfolio — anything showing you think about products unprompted.



  





**WHY 1ACRE**

 Every honest fix here protects someone's life savings.

 We ship with modern AI tooling, we don't just talk about it.

 Your work goes live, not into a backlog.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Associate Workspace
jobs.job_function: Project Management, Management, and Product Management
jobs.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through a large and diverse global workforce. The experience our Customer Service Associates have at work directly affects their ability to successfully serve customers.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to reimagine the day\-to\-day experience of being a Customer Service Associate and define the future of our Associate Workspace.
   

  

 Our ambition is to make work simpler, more personalized, connected and engaging. Associates should have a coherent experience through which they can manage their workday, understand what matters to them, stay informed about changes, see their performance and progress, interact with their teams, and feel recognized for the work they do.
   

  

 Today, many of these experiences are fragmented across different tools, systems and communication channels. The opportunity is not simply to aggregate them into a single interface. It is to rethink the experience from first principles around what associates need to successfully navigate and engage with their work.
   

  

 Imagine an experience that understands each associate and their context and helps answer: What do I need to know today? What has changed? What actions do I need to take? How am I doing? What opportunities are available to me? How can I better connect with my team and organization?
   

  

 The opportunity also extends beyond simplifying work. We want to explore how recognition, community, interaction and thoughtfully designed engagement mechanisms can make work more motivating and connected. This could include new ways to celebrate progress and achievements, create team experiences, or use gamification to make appropriate aspects of work more engaging, while thoughtfully navigating privacy, regulatory and cultural considerations across our global workforce.
   

  

 As the Principal PM, you will define the long\-term product vision and strategy for this experience. You will determine how capabilities spanning work management, communications, performance visibility, recognition, engagement and personalization should come together into a coherent product.
   

  

 This is a highly ambiguous, zero\-to\-one role with significant cross\-organizational scope. Many underlying capabilities will continue to be owned by other teams. You will establish the product experience and architecture that brings them together, influence partner roadmaps, and align senior Product, Engineering, UX, Science and Operations leaders around a common direction.
   

  

 You will also define how AI and associate context can make the experience increasingly proactive and personalized, reducing friction and cognitive load while giving associates greater visibility and control over their work experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a product leader who can move fluidly between customer insight, product strategy and technology. You should be comfortable identifying opportunities that are not yet well defined, creating clarity from ambiguity, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and translating a long\-term vision into incremental customer value.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As the Principal Product Manager for Associate Workspace, you will:
   

  

* Define the long\-term vision, product strategy and roadmap for the day\-to\-day associate experience across Amazon Customer Service.
* Work directly with associates and Operations to identify the most important problems and opportunities to improve their experience at work.
* Define a coherent experience spanning areas such as work and schedule management, communications and change, performance and progress visibility, recognition, community, engagement and interaction.
* Develop new ways to make work more engaging, including recognition, team experiences and gamification, while partnering with Legal, HR and other teams to ensure experiences are appropriate for a diverse global workforce.
* Define how associate context and personalization should shape the information, actions and experiences surfaced to each associate.
* Establish product principles and architecture that allow capabilities owned by multiple organizations and systems to behave as a unified experience.
* Define how AI can simplify the associate experience, reduce cognitive load and make the Workspace increasingly proactive and personalized.
* Partner with senior Engineering and UX leaders to make product and technical choices that enable the long\-term vision while delivering value incrementally.
* Establish and influence cross\-organizational roadmaps, priorities and ownership boundaries required to deliver the experience.
* Define success measures that go beyond adoption to understand tool effectiveness, friction, cognitive load, effort, engagement and associate experience, and connect improvements where possible to operational and customer outcomes.
* Influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations and partner organizations to align around and deliver a common associate experience.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* 10\+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience owning technology products

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Procurement Data Excellence & Governance
jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

***Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.***


Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.


The Global Procurement team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best\-in\-class total cost and supply chain resiliency through innovative predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members, our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills\-based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to ignite your talent.


As **Senior Manager, Data Excellence \& Governance** within Global Procurement’s Digital Transformation \& AI organization, you will lead the function that makes procurement data trusted, measurable, and ready for AI. You own data governance and quality operations, Global Procurement performance metrics and reporting, and the procurement data strategy — and you lead a multi\-region team across Singapore, the United States, India, and Malaysia.


Data readiness is the single largest constraint to unlocking value from AI, automation, and analytics in procurement. A core part of your mandate is to reimagine the data governance and excellence operating model with AI agents embedded — redefining how policies, quality monitoring, lineage, and stewardship operate when agents handle detection, enrichment, routing, and maintenance, and where people focus on exception handling, governance, and continuous improvement. Success is measured by whether prioritized workflows run on trusted, agent\-consumable data, and whether the data foundation strengthens itself through automated feedback loops rather than manual clean\-up.

**This is a people\-leadership role.** You will develop a team of data governance and analytics professionals, set the standards and stewardship model for procurement data, and partner closely with AI Transformation, Data \& Process Automation, Platform Excellence, IT, Security, and Compliance to ensure the data foundation aligns with enterprise platforms, ERP readiness, and enterprise data governance standards.

* **Key Responsibilities**
*A core expectation is to move procurement’s data function from reactive clean\-up to an agent\-embedded, self\-improving operating model — where governance is executable, quality is measurable, and business value is demonstrable.*

**Data Governance \& Quality Operations**

* Own the procurement data governance framework — policies, standards, decision rights, and the data stewardship operating model — and ensure it is applied consistently across systems and regions.
* Lead data quality and master data operations (Vendor Master, Material Master, spend, category taxonomy), moving from recurring manual clean\-up toward monitored, controlled, and preventable quality at the source.
* Shift governance from static documents to executable rules — champion lightweight, machine\-readable policies and standards that agents can enforce automatically.
* Align data handling with enterprise controls — sensitivity labels, data loss prevention, and approved access — so data can be used safely by both people and AI agents.

**Business Value \& Performance Measurement**

* Own Global Procurement KPIs, metrics, and program reporting — providing leaders with a single, trusted source for performance and value.
* Lead the labor productivity and business value agenda: define, quantify, and report the value realized from transformation, automation, and AI initiatives.
* Establish data quality KPIs, service level agreements, and monitoring so quality and value are managed with evidence, not assumed.

**Procurement Data Strategy \& AI Readiness**

* Reimagine the data governance and excellence operating model with agents embedded — defining the target model, the agentic patterns that apply (data quality agent, lineage agent, maintenance agent, steward copilot), and a getting\-started roadmap sequenced against ERP and transformation milestones.
* Set and drive the procurement data strategy, prioritizing the Critical Data Elements that carry the most downstream value.
* Partner with the AI Data Strategist and agent build leads to define the data elements, quality thresholds, and validation rules each agent needs — mapping every business requirement to a source, owner, and readiness action.
* Direct the design of the feedback loop between agent, source system, and steward so validation, correction, and prevention happen without manual clean\-up wherever feasible.

**Data Lineage \& Technical Foundations**

* Direct the working\-level technical foundations that make the agentic model possible — data lineage, relationships, schema, and cross\-system mapping — so downstream impact is traceable before a change lands.
* Stand up and maintain a searchable data dictionary, business glossary, documentation, versioning, and change history that both people and agents can query and update.
* Define control points at the point of entry so quality is protected where data originates.

**Innovation \& Reusable Assets**

* Sponsor rapid experiments on agentic data patterns, validate impact, and turn the best into reusable building blocks for broader adoption across Source\-to\-Pay.
* Pilot AI\-based data validation and cleansing tools and assess fit against Micron’s data landscape.

jobs.description:
**Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for** ***all*****.**

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

**About Micron**


Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all. Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate, and advance faster than ever. The Global Procurement (GP) team is an integral engine to Micron’s growth, delivering best‑in‑class total cost and supply chain resiliency through cutting‑edge predictive capabilities, risk analysis, and a focus on sustainability and diversity. Our business goals are directly tied to the value we place on our team members—our greatest asset. We invest in our people through a skills‑based learning and development model to create clear career pathways for growth. Join us and discover why Micron’s Global Procurement team is the preferred destination to unleash your talent.

 **Role Overview**


The Data Governance Analyst supports Global Procurement by enabling trusted, standardized, and AI‑ready procurement data that drives productivity, business value, and transformation outcomes. This role plays a hands‑on, execution‑focused part in operationalizing data governance, improving master data quality, and enabling consistent KPI and program reporting across GP.

  

The analyst connects day‑to‑day data governance and stewardship activities to measurable procurement outcomes, reducing manual effort, improving decision quality, and accelerating adoption of analytics, automation, and AI capabilities.

  

This is not an IT or Business Intelligence role. The analyst partners closely with GP business teams, Master Data, Analytics, AI, and IT functions to align with enterprise data standards, controls, and approved platforms.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **GP KPIs, Metrics \& Program Reporting**

* Support GP KPI frameworks by ensuring metric definitions, data sources, and calculations are clearly defined, standardized, and auditable.
* Enable consistent, trusted program and transformation reporting by improving data reliability and transparency.
* Partner with GP program owners to align reporting needs with governed data sources and approved definitions.
 **Data Governance \& Quality Operations**

* Execute day\-to\-day procurement data governance activities, including stewardship support, data quality monitoring, issue intake, and remediation tracking.
* Support the procurement data stewardship operating model, including routines, escalation paths, and documentation.
* Define and maintain governance artifacts such as business glossaries, critical data elements, and business rules for key procurement datasets.
* Track and report data quality KPIs (e.g., completeness, accuracy, duplication, timeliness) and support root cause analysis with data and process owners.
* Leveraging AI to improve productivity.
 **Procurement Master Data Management****,****Process Intelligence \& Continuous Improvement**

* Perform hands\-on procurement master data cleanup and standardization activities (supplier, category, material, contract, and reference data).
* Coordinate with Master Data and process owners to resolve data quality issues at the source and prevent recurrence.
* Support continuous improvement of master data processes and controls.
* **Leverage****Celonis****process intelligence and process mining** **capabilities****to****identify****procurement data quality issues, process inefficiencies, and root causes****impacting****business performance.**
* **Partner with Procurement, Master Data, and Process Owners to translate****Celonis****insights into actionable data governance****, master data, and process improvement initiatives.**
* **Support the development and monitoring of procurement data quality and process KPIs through****Celonis****and approved enterprise reporting platforms.**
* Act as a subject matter expert for procurement process intelligence, ensuring data governance improvements are aligned to measurable business outcomes.
 **AI****Ready Procurement Data Enablement**

* Contribute to procurement master data strategy required to enable AI, automation, and advanced analytics use cases.
* Partner with analytics and AI teams to translate use case requirements into actionable data governance and data quality improvements.
* Ensure procurement data is structured, labeled, and governed to be AI ready, with clear ownership, definitions, and quality thresholds.
 **Cross****Functional Collaboration**

* Act as a liaison between GP business teams, Analytics, AI, Master Data, and IT for data related topics.
* Support alignment between procurement specific needs and enterprise data governance standards.
 **Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field required.
* Advanced degree or certification in data management, analytics, or governance is a plus.
* Practical experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Snowflake) is required.
**Experience**

* Minimum 7 years of experience in data governance, data quality, reporting and Celonis SME
* Hands‑on experience with master data management and data quality operations, preferably in Procurement or Supply Chain domains.

This individual will execute converting the product vision and roadmap into workable product requirements for engineering to meet product roadmap expectations defined by the Portfolio Manager. jobs.title: Sr Product Owner - Technical Product Management [T500-28887]
jobs.description:
**About T\-Mobile:** 




 T\-Mobile US, Inc. (NASDAQ: TMUS), headquartered in Bellevue, Washington, is America’s supercharged Un\-carrier, connecting millions through its strong nationwide network and flagship brands, T\-Mobile and Metro by T\-Mobile. Customers benefit from an unmatched combination of value, quality, and exceptional service experience.
 



  





**TMUS Global Solutions:** 




 TMUS Global Solutions
 
 is a world\-class technology powerhouse accelerating the company’s global digital transformation. With a culture built on growth, inclusivity, and global collaboration, the teams here drive innovation at scale, powered by bold thinking.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 The Senior Product Owner is accountable for backlog strategy, prioritization, and requirements definition for T\-Mobile’s offshore AI Platform \& Reliability Engineering organization. This role owns what gets built and in what order across AI platform capabilities, agent systems, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt reduction, and operational excellence investments. The role ensures engineering investments remain aligned with business priorities while balancing feature delivery, platform sustainability, operational excellence, and technical debt reduction.
 



  





 The Senior Product Owner serves as the product\-side decision\-maker for backlog prioritization, partnering closely with the Manager, Software Engineering \- AI Platform \& Reliability Engineering, who owns delivery execution, engineering operations, people leadership, and production reliability. The role reports to the Manager with a dotted\-line relationship to onshore Product Management to ensure alignment with strategic product direction.
 



 Success is measured through prioritization quality, roadmap alignment, backlog readiness, reduction of engineering rework, stakeholder alignment, and the team’s ability to consistently execute against business and platform objectives. We pride ourselves on encouraging a culture of innovation, agile ways of working, and transparency in all we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the Un\-carrier and making a tangible impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 



* Own backlog strategy, prioritization, and sequencing across AI platform capabilities, platform engineering initiatives, reliability improvements, technical debt, and operational excellence investments.
* Translate product strategy and roadmap objectives into well\-defined epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are ready for engineering execution.
* Partner with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to ensure backlog priorities align with platform architecture, engineering capacity, and business objectives.
* Balance competing priorities across feature delivery, platform sustainability, scalability, reliability, and technical debt while clearly communicating tradeoffs.
* Prioritize AI platform capabilities including agent orchestration, conversational platforms, SDKs, enterprise integrations, and Model Context Protocol (MCP)\-enabled capabilities.
* Ensure production readiness, operational excellence, and reliability engineering initiatives are appropriately represented within backlog priorities.
* Collaborate with onshore Product Management to align offshore engineering execution with product strategy and roadmap objectives.
* Coordinate dependencies across engineering teams, architects, Product Owners, and platform stakeholders to improve delivery predictability.
* Accept completed work against defined business and technical acceptance criteria.
* Use engineering metrics, operational insights, customer feedback, and platform health indicators to continuously refine backlog priorities and roadmap sequencing.



  





**What You'll Bring:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years of experience in Product Owner, Product Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering, or related roles.
* Demonstrated experience owning prioritization decisions for complex engineering organizations supporting multiple workstreams and competing business priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to operate in technically complex environments involving distributed systems, cloud\-native platforms, AI\-powered services, platform engineering, or reliability engineering.
* Proven experience managing backlogs that include feature delivery, platform investments, technical debt reduction, and reliability engineering work.
* Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, microservices, data flows, and software delivery practices.
* Experience partnering with engineering managers, architects, and technical leads to balance roadmap objectives with platform sustainability and operational excellence.
* Strong communication, facilitation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.



  





**Must Have Skills** 
 :
 


* Product ownership, backlog strategy, and prioritization
* Technical requirements definition and acceptance criteria
* Agile product delivery and sprint readiness
* Cloud\-native platforms, APIs, and distributed systems
* Stakeholder, dependency, and tradeoff management



  





**Nice\-to\-Have:** 



* Experience working with AI platforms, conversational AI systems, LLM\-powered services, or AI infrastructure.
* Experience working with SRE, platform engineering, or cloud operations teams.
* Familiarity with reliability engineering concepts, including SLOs, SLAs, observability, incident management, and operational excellence practices.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to use operational data, usage metrics, and production insights to drive prioritization decisions.
* Experience supporting enterprise\-scale platforms serving large customer\-facing applications.

**Role Summary**
 The AI Business Analyst will turn operational data into actionable intelligence for Release Management, Program Management Office, End\-to\-End QA, Operational Deployments, QA integrations, and environment telemetry. The AI Business Analyst will act as a bridge between operational teams and AI\-enabled delivery practices: translating raw signals into root\-cause insights, converting recurring manual activities into automation backlog items, documenting remediation runbooks, and ensuring that findings are mapped to the teams that own the relevant operational processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Analyze ServiceNow incident, request, change, catalog task, approval, SLA, and closure data to identify operational bottlenecks, recurring handoff delays, aging queues, rework loops, and ownership ambiguity across SaaS Operations teams.
* Mine Jira workflows to detect process misalignments such as linked Jira issues that remain open after upstream or dependent tickets reach defined DONE state, inconsistent transition usage, missing closure evidence, incomplete acceptance criteria, and stale dependencies.

jobs.description:
**Business Analyst/QA Analyst** 




  





 Company: Prospect Infosystem LLP
 



 Location: Gachibowli
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Shift Timing: 2:00 PM – 11:00 PM (Evening Shift)
 



 Working Days: Monday to Friday
 



 Experience Required:
 **2 Years to 5 Years only** 




**Salary: ₹30,000 per month** 




  





 About the Role
 



  





 Prospect Infosystem is looking for a versatile Business Analyst cum QA Analyst to join our evening shift team. This is a hybrid role suited to someone who enjoys owning a feature end\-to\-end — from understanding what the client needs, to defining it clearly for the team, to making sure what gets built actually works as intended. You'll be the thread connecting requirements to delivery, translating business needs into specifications and then validating that the final product meets them.
 



  





 This role is ideal for a candidate who wants broader ownership of the product lifecycle rather than working in a narrow, siloed function.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 Requirement Ownership
 



  





 Gather, analyze, and document business requirements from clients and internal stakeholders
 



 Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
 



 Create process flows, wireframes, and documentation (BRD/FRD/SRS)
 



 Liaise with clients — including international clients — during evening/overlapping time zones
 



  





 Delivery Collaboration
 



  





 Work closely with project managers and developers to ensure requirements are correctly understood and implemented
 



 Identify gaps, risks, and process improvement opportunities throughout the project lifecycle
 



 Participate in sprint planning and reviews, representing both the business and quality perspective
 



  





 Quality Validation
 



  





 Design test cases and scenarios directly from the requirements you've defined, ensuring nothing is lost in translation
 



 Execute functional, regression, and UAT to confirm the delivered product matches the original business intent
 



 Log, track, and manage defects through to closure using tools like JIRA
 



 Own traceability between requirements, test cases, and final deliverables
 



 Sign off on releases with confidence that both the "what was asked" and "what was built" are aligned
 



 What Makes This Role Different
 



  





 Because you'll define the requirements and validate the outcome, you'll have full visibility and accountability across the project — reducing handoff gaps between business and QA teams and giving you a real say in what "done" means.
 



  





 Required Skills \& Qualifications
 



 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, IT, Computer Science, or related field
 



 Minimum 2 years of experience in a Business Analyst, QA, or hybrid BA/QA role
 



 Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile/Scrum methodologies
 



 Proficiency with tools like MS Excel, JIRA, Confluence, or similar
 



 Solid grasp of manual testing concepts and structured test documentation
 



 Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both client\-facing and internal collaboration
 



 Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail
 



 Comfortable owning a task from requirement gathering through to quality sign\-off
 



 Available for evening shift (2 PM – 11 PM), Monday to Friday
 



 Good to Have
 



 Experience working with international/US/UK clients
 



 Basic knowledge of UI/UX principles
 



 Familiarity with SQL or basic data analysis
 



 Exposure to automation testing tools (Selenium, Postman, etc.)
 



 Prior experience in a software development company
 



  





  





 With Regards,
 



  





 Nemani Namrata
 



 Senior HR
 



 EMAIL:
 **hr@prospectinfosystem.com** 




 IT takes talent and Prospect Infosystem, delivers.
 



 5th Floor, A\-Block, Sandil Building, Plot No\- 56, Chhota Anajaih Nagar, Gachibowli, Hyderabad \- TS 500032\.
