jobs.description:
**Role:** Product Manager \- AI Services

**Location:** Flexible \- remote, hybrid, or based at an Esko location. (Worldwide locations considered.)  

**Function:** Product Management  

**Reports to:** Director, Packaging Intelligence

**About the role**
------------------


As Product Manager for AI Services, you will own the product lifecycle for a shared foundation of AI capabilities that Esko's internal teams build on rather than re\-invent \- enabling them to solve customer problems that were previously out of reach with optimal speed and efficiency.


Cross\-functional collaboration sits at the core of the role. You will coach internal teams, consolidate their needs to find common ground, work with technical and design stakeholders to agree the best approach, and document clear, testable requirements that are reviewed and approved before development begins. The result is a coherent, prioritized backlog and roadmap that reflects the combined needs of Esko's product teams and aligns with company strategy and AI transformation objectives.


You will keep stakeholders updated as work progresses, then support them through acceptance testing, triage and implement change requests, and drive adoption of the services in production. Ongoing success management is central: keeping services aligned with evolving team and customer needs while maintaining a generalized approach and backwards compatibility, and growing capabilities in line with advances in technology and market expectations. You will track adoption and key performance metrics to demonstrate impact and identify where more focus is needed.


As a key member of the Esko AI team, you will also help shape the strategic vision for Esko's AI initiatives through brainstorming, thought leadership, customer discussions and events.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Own and prioritize the product backlog for AI Services – a shared collection of common AI capabilities leveraged by Esko product and engineering teams.
* Proactively gather needs from cross\-functional product teams and turn them into clear, well\-scoped requirements for the Esko AI engineering teams.
* Act as a bridge between Esko AI and other cross\-functional teams \- product, engineering, and commercial – to ensure their success in building AI\-powered capabilities that deliver on the intended customer value.
* Help other teams to bootstrap their own AI initiatives on top of the shared capabilities: clarifying what already exists, what needs to be built, and how to get started.

* Experience in packaging graphics or the wider graphic arts industry is strongly preferred.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* Teams across the business ship AI\-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation of AI Services, rather than “re\-inventing the wheel”.

jobs.description:
**About Us**
 Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America’s leading retailers.
   

  

**Supply Chain and Logistics**
 Target Global Supply Chain and Logistics is evolving at an incredible pace. We are constantly reimagining how we get the right product to the guest even better, faster and more cost effectively than before. We are becoming more intelligent, automated and algorithmic in our decision\-making, so that no matter how guests shop—in stores or on Target.com—we deliver the convenience and immediate gratification they demand and deserve. We are on a mission to win decisively over any competitor, with a seamless and superior guest service experience unlike any they can offer. Our teams work with the agility our mission requires, and we constantly come together to implement new processes in record time. So we’re looking for exceptional people who are proactive, creative, independent, innovative, risk\-savvy and comfortable working in varying degrees of ambiguity. Are you a critical thinker who seeks the root cause and can analyze both qualitatively and quantitatively? Are you a creative problem\-solver who simplifies problems, quickly identifies solutions, commits to a plan and then positively influences others to execute it? If so, you will have success on one of our dynamic teams.
   

  

**Network Planning and Global Intelligence**
 A role in Network Planning and Global Intelligence means creating industry leading intelligence solutions to drive best in class omni\-channel guest experiences at the lowest cost to Target. You might focus on enabling the future transportation operating model, optimizing inventory management, driving topology planning or leveraging deep business insights and analytics to propel Target’s Supply Chain. As a network steward, we create forecasts, design inventory optimization strategies and leverage technology to ensure our inventory is available at the right time, in the right places and quantity to meet the needs of our guest, stores and operational goals. Super\-powered first and foremost by our people, and supported by robust process and technology, we are a team of data\-focused, curious minds who love to solve hard problems to enable a dynamic, fast paced Supply Chain Network.
   

  

**About The Job**
 As a Sr. Product Manager in transportation, you’ll be responsible for creating capabilities to improve the speed, visibility, accuracy, and precision of Target’s supply chain. You will define and facilitate implementation of new technology solutions to onboard and integrate with transportation carriers supporting the movement of goods across all miles and all modes of transportation.
   

  

 The desired candidate would have a strong background in supply chain, transportation operations, carrier integration patterns such as Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), experience with load tracking systems, as well as familiarity with supply chain systems interoperability across a broad ecosystem (vendor, purchasing, WMS, TMS, EDI, freight payment, etc).
   

  

 Product Teams at Target Corporation are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology and design work.
   

  

 As a Sr. Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will lead the development of a comprehensive product strategy and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product domain. You will need to leverage extensive knowledge of your product, as well as, customer feedback, key data and analytics, and other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product.
   

  

 You will be the “voice of the product” to all outside stakeholders advocating for your product and ensuring their needs are met and that the product team is getting the leadership and support that it needs to be successful. You will need to cultivate strong relationships across the enterprise in order to drive collaboration and alignment with key partners and stakeholders across pyramids.
   

  

 You will develop and actively maintain a product roadmap outlining prioritization for the customer themes, technical needs, and design challenges to be delivered and you will be accountable to make final decisions on scope and prioritization relative to the product backlog.  There are millions of small and medium businesses across international stores such as India, LatAm, Europe, Middle East, Japan etc. who sign up as sellers on Amazon. The Seller AI team within International Seller Services organization is focused on helping sellers with the right set of Gen\-AI/LLM powered tools and agentic solutions that can enable them to accelerate business growth on Amazon.
   

  

 If you like to swim in unchartered territories then this is your opportunity to solve problems that no one has attempted to solve before. We work like a well\-funded, high speed startup driven by the passion to bring the best in class AI powered experiences to our selling partners across international stores. This role is responsible for driving a roadmap for some of the most critical AI and Agentic experiences and enablers to help new and tenured sellers succeed and grow their business across international stores.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Product Manager, you will be expected to come up with the PR/FAQ, vision, and business requirements for the some of the most impactful Gen\-AI/LLM based experiences for our selling partners. This will need you to understand pain points of various types of sellers, prioritize business needs that could be different across countries, while coming up with well thought out product ideas as well as have a good command on latest advancements in AI technology (e.g. Generative AI, Large Language Models, etc). You will launch products, and take them to market, demonstrating business impact across several international countries.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic about managing challenging, complex and ambiguous projects across multiple teams and locations. We are looking for a tenured Product leader who shares Amazon's passion for the customer—someone who understands the importance of compelling features and functionalities in driving great experience. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Labs
jobs.description:
**About the Company** 





 Dentira is one of the fastest\-growing, profitable healthcare startups that is revolutionizing clinic operations across multiple countries. Our flagship product transformed dental procurement by introducing the world’s first real\-time price and product comparison engine for dental supplies in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand. Building on this success, our latest innovation, the Lab Platform, streamlines case creation and management by seamlessly connecting clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs. We are also pioneering the use of advanced AI technologies to tackle complex challenges like Automatic Invoice Reconciliation, procedure cost prediction etc that can be applied across various healthcare verticals that we cater to. 
 





 As we continue to expand, we are actively exploring adjacent verticals and new avenues for growth while strengthening our presence in existing ones. Our ambitious goal is to achieve over 10X growth within the next 3 years. 
 




  





**About the Role** 





 Dentira's Lab Platform connects clinics, intraoral scanners, and dental labs, streamlining case creation and management end\-to\-end. As Senior Product Manager for the Labs team, you will own the product experience for scaling this platform, driving adoption across clinics and building deep, reliable integrations with the Lab Management Systems (LMS) that dental labs run on. You'll define the strategy and roadmap for one of our fastest\-growing product areas, partnering with Engineering, Design, Account Management, and Operations across our global markets.
 




  






 This is an individual\-contributor role, ideal for someone who's energized by platform and integration problems, comfortable owning a roadmap end\-to\-end, and motivated by building tools that connect previously disconnected workflows for clinics and labs alike.
 




  





**What You'll need to do** 



* Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for scaling the Lab Platform across clinics and dental labs, translating market and user needs into a prioritized plan.
* Lead your product area's full lifecycle — from opportunity discovery and PRDs through launch, GTM, and post\-launch iteration.
* Own the strategy for integrating with third\-party Lab Management Systems (LMS) and other lab/clinic software, partnering closely with Engineering to build integrations that are reliable and scalable.
* Be customer obsessed. Be the voice of the clinic and lab internally: bring behavioral data, usability research, and direct feedback from both sides of the workflow into every major product decision.
* Partner with global cross\-functional teams \- Account Management, Operations, Design, and Engineering to ship tools that are intuitive, scalable, and reliable for clinics and labs alike.
* Define clear goals and KPIs for Lab Platform adoption and usage; build hypotheses, run experiments, and measure impact rigorously.
* Maintain clear, consistent product documentation (PRDs, prototypes, release notes) so stakeholders always know what's shipping and why.
* Represent your roadmap and results in executive reviews and cross\-functional forums.



  





**Basic Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree with a strong academic background.
* 4\+ years of product management experience, including shipping both 0\-to\-1 and scaled products, with a track record of taking a product from early traction to broad adoption.
* Customer obsession. Understand key clinic and lab pain points based on data, usability sessions, and effective user research.
* Strong data fluency. Comfortable pulling and interpreting data independently to inform and defend product decisions.
* Execution rigor. Experience owning the full product lifecycle — vision → roadmap → launch → GTM.
* Experience working cross\-functionally (Engineering, Design, Program Management, Finance, Marketing) in a global, decentralized organization.
* High ownership and a bias for action. You'll do whatever it takes to make your product and team successful.
* Structured thinking. Ability to bring structure to a high\-complexity, high\-ambiguity setup.
* Influence without authority. Ability to inspire and rally a cross\-functional team around a clear vision, strategy, and execution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* High EQ and a track record of building trust with both internal teams and external stakeholders (e.g., clinics, labs, partners).



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience building products for two\-sided or multi\-party ecosystems (e.g., connecting distinct user groups like clinics and labs).
* Experience with system integrations or APIs, especially with third\-party practice management, lab management, or scanner/imaging software.
* Experience in healthcare, dental, or other regulated industries.
* Experience working across global teams in the US, Canada, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and India.
* Comfortable building with AI and agentic product patterns
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving cross\-functional alignment in a fast\-paced environment.
* Demonstrated long\-term thinking around strategic and business\-focused goals.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us** 




 Scapia! A credit card that’s out there to make travel happen for people, by converting their everyday expenses into travel experiences. We’re a bunch of passionate people who work together, brainstorm, and debate with each other, and don’t stop until we’re proud of our work. Customer delight tops everything else! We’ve worked hard to create an environment of honesty and passion that sets everyone up for success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for Group Product Manager to Group Product Manager to lead our Storefront, Recommendations \& CRM
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Build the systems that recognize who a user is and serve them something relevant, on the surfaces that matter, through the channels where they are present.
 



  





 This role owns four connected goals:
 



  





 Maximize LTV through personalized discovery and cross\-sell
 



 Build the recommendations platform that powers contextual discovery across homepage, inner pages, order confirmation, and coin pages. The job is to move users through activation, habit formation, retention, and monetization, not just show them more inventory.
 



  





 Deliver a best\-in\-class app and web experience
 



 Reduce performance and reliability friction across the journey: app size, app start time, crash\-free rate, app load time, app\-open\-to\-home latency, and web metrics (FCP, LCP, landing page optimization). This is the foundation the recommendations platform sits on.
 



  





 Build a unified view of customer intent
 



 Combine behavioral and declared signals into a single, coherent picture of what each user wants and when. This powers personalization today and future monetization surfaces including ads, where Scapia's travel\-financial identity graph becomes something advertisers pay to reach.
 



  





 Own communication as a product surface
 



 Build in\-app notifications and CRM systems that optimize for reach and open rate without degrading user trust. Scapia's new and existing cohorts each need a different message, cadence and channel. Getting it right is one of the highest\-leverage, lowest\-cost retention levers available.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* The recommendations platform roadmap, surfaces, user signals, context and supply signals that go into the models
* App performance and web performance workstreams, partnering closely with platform and infra engineering
* The customer data and signals strategy that unifies behavioral and declared intent
* CRM and in\-app notification systems, including segmentation logic and trust guardrails



  





**What We’re Looking For** 



* 7\+ years in product management, with at least 2\-3 years owning a recommendations, personalization, or lifecycle marketing system at meaningful scale
* Demonstrated ability to reason about cohorts, not averages: you segment users by behavior and design differently for each segment rather than shipping one experience for everyone
* Working fluency with app performance metrics (crash\-free rate, cold start time) and web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals), even if you haven't personally owned an infra roadmap
* Experience partnering with data science or ML teams on signal design, feature stores, or recommendation models
* A track record of building CRM or notification systems that grew engagement without eroding trust or triggering fatigue/opt\-outs
* Comfort managing PMs and running a multi\-workstream charter, not just a single feature line
* Financial services, travel, or loyalty/rewards experience is a plus, not a requirement

Yubi, formerly known as CredAvenue, is re\-defining global debt markets by freeing the flow of finance between borrowers, lenders, and investors. We are the world's possibility platform for the discovery, investment, fulfillment, and collection of any debt solution. At Yubi, opportunities are plenty and we equip you with tools to seize it.
 



  





 In March 2022, we became India's fastest fintech and most impactful startup to join the unicorn club with a Series B fundraising round of $137 million.
 



  





 In 2020, we began our journey with a vision of transforming and deepening the global institutional debt market through technology. Our two\-sided debt marketplace helps institutional and HNI investors find the widest network of corporate borrowers and debt products on one side and helps corporates to discover investors and access debt capital efficiently on the other side. Switching between platforms is easy, which means investors can lend, invest and trade bonds \- all in one place. All of our platforms shake up the traditional debt ecosystem and offer new ways of digital finance.
 



  





**Yubi Credit Marketplace** 
 \- With the largest selection of lenders on one platform, our credit marketplace helps enterprises partner with lenders of their choice for any and all capital requirements.
 



**Yubi Invest** 
 \- Fixed income securities platform for wealth managers \& financial advisors to channel client investments in fixed income
 



**Financial Services Platform** 
 \- Designed for financial institutions to manage co\-lending partnerships \& asset based securitization
 



**Spocto** 
 \- Debt recovery \& risk mitigation platform
 



**Corpository** 
 \- Dedicated SaaS solutions platform powered by Decision\-grade data, Analytics, Pattern Identifications, Early Warning Signals and Predictions to Lenders, Investors and Business Enterprises
 



  





 So far, we have on\-boarded over 17000\+ enterprises, 6200\+ investors \& lenders and have facilitated debt volumes of over INR 1,40,000 crore.
 



 Backed by marquee investors like Insight Partners, B Capital Group, Dragoneer, Sequoia Capital, LightSpeed and Lightrock, we are the only\-of\-its\-kind debt platform globally, revolutionizing the segment.

We are a fun bunch who are highly motivated and driven to create a purposeful impact. Come, join the club to be a part of our epic growth story.

 : Create and maintain a product roadmap that prioritizes features and enhancements based on business objectives, customer feedback, and market demands.
* **Feature Definition:** 
 Clearly define and prioritize product features, ensuring they meet the requirements of B2B clients and contribute to the overall success of the product.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 : Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support teams to ensure successful product development and launch.
* **Requirements Gathering** 
 : Collect and document detailed product requirements from stakeholders and customers. Translate these requirements into clear and actionable tasks for the development team.
* **Project Management** 
 : Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality products. Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets.
* **User Experience Focus** 
 : Advocate for the end\-user by ensuring products are intuitive, user\-friendly, and deliver a seamless experience. Conduct user testing and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* **Performance Monitoring** 
 : Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success. Use data\-driven insights to make informed decisions and adjustments.
* **Compliance and Security** 
 : Ensure that products comply with relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Prioritize security and data privacy in product design and development.
* **Stakeholder Communication** 
 : Maintain transparent and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on product status, milestones, and changes.



  





 Requirements

* Proven track record of successfully launching and managing fintech products.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.

 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 






 DigiCert is looking for a Product Manager to help build the next generation of DNS posture management capabilities for enterprise customers. This role will focus on AI\-enabled DNS products that strengthen security, reliability, performance, automation, and operational insight \- helping redefine DNS as an AI\-native trust layer for the modern Internet.
 





 As a Product Manager, you will own well\-defined product areas within DigiCert’s broader DNS roadmap. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, ML Ops, product marketing, sales, and customer\-facing teams to translate customer needs, DNS telemetry, and technical capabilities into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
 





 This is a hands\-on product role for a builder who can move quickly, use data to make decisions, and partner deeply with technical teams. You will help validate new ideas, prototype posture workflows, define requirements, support launches, and iterate continuously while maintaining enterprise standards for security, reliability, and customer trust.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Define, prioritize, and deliver AI\-enabled DNS product capabilities within DigiCert’s broader DNS roadmap, aligned with the company’s trust and cloud strategy.
* Translate customer problems, DNS telemetry, AI/ML capabilities, and market insights into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, and MLOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, cloud\-native DNS services.
* Use AI\-assisted product and prototyping tools to analyze feedback, synthesize insights, explore workflows, and validate ideas early with customers and engineers.
* Develop product capabilities across DNS resolution, traffic management, observability, automation, anomaly detection, posture management, and security use cases.
* Define and track success metrics such as adoption, latency, reliability, automation effectiveness, anomaly\-detection quality, and trust\-signal accuracy.
* Support product\-side GTM execution in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, including launch planning, messaging input, enablement, pricing input, and adoption tracking.
* Engage customers, partners, internal field teams, and relevant standards communities to validate use cases and inform roadmap priorities.
* Use telemetry, dashboards, customer feedback, experimentation, and A/B testing where appropriate to guide prioritization and measure product impact.
* Rapidly validate ideas, deliver incremental value, and iterate continuously without compromising security, reliability, performance, or customer trust.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* 4\+ years of product management experience in cloud, networking, security, infrastructure SaaS, developer platforms, or technical B2B products.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams building on AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar cloud platforms.
* Understanding of DNS, networking, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or adjacent technical domains.
* Familiarity with AI/ML product concepts such as inference workflows, automation, anomaly detection, model evaluation, or MLOps collaboration.
* Experience translating ambiguous technical problems into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Proven ability to deliver 0→1 or early\-stage product capabilities and iterate rapidly in agile environments.
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills, with the ability to use data, customer insights, and technical tradeoffs to drive product decisions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted tools such as Figma, Cursor, Copilot, or similar tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, feedback synthesis, or requirements development.
* Experience supporting GTM activities such as launches, collateral, enablement, pricing input, customer adoption, or success tracking.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, product marketing, sales, customer success, support, and leadership stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with an ownership mindset, strong attention to detail, and a passion for building secure, reliable, enterprise\-grade infrastructure products.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Experience with DNS, traffic management, network security, observability, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience bringing startup\-style urgency to enterprise\-grade products.
* Builder mindset with comfort operating in ambiguous 0→1 environments.
* Strong instincts for security, trust, automation, and operational resilience.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native and open\-source infrastructure ecosystems.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies.
* Top shelf benefits.
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support.

**Z1 is Looking for:**

**About Us**
 We solves large, complex AI problems and builds the platforms that enable companies to use AI for large\-scale business transformation.
   

  

 We operate in a technology space that is rapidly becoming one of the most important layers of the modern enterprise. As AI moves from isolated experiments to becoming embedded across businesses, companies need fundamentally new technology platforms that can bring together models, enterprise data, organizational context, workflows, applications and people at scale.
   

  

 Our enterprise AI platform forms the foundation of our transformation work. We use this platform to configure and extend AI\-native solutions around how each organization operates, rather than approaching every customer problem as a bespoke software development exercise.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Product Manager – AI Transformation, you will be a central owner of our AI transformation deployments, responsible for translating complex business problems into AI products and driving them through successful delivery.
   

  

 Our customers engage us to transform meaningful parts of how their businesses operate. You will be responsible for understanding the business context and problem, defining the scope, designing the solution, determining how our platform should be applied or extended, and working closely with engineering through implementation and deployment.
   

  

 This requires strong first\-principles thinking. Customer requirements are important inputs, but they are not necessarily the solution. You need to understand the underlying problem, question assumptions and develop an independent view of what will create the most value.
   

  

 This is also an execution\-intensive role. Product ownership here does not end with a PRD, prototype or roadmap. A significant part of the job is coordinating dependencies, resolving open questions, reviewing builds, aligning stakeholders and doing the detailed work required to get a product successfully delivered.
   

  

 Our primary market is the United States, making this a highly external\-facing role. You will regularly work with senior US stakeholders and should be comfortable with the communication standards, ownership and working\-hour flexibility that requires.

 Develop a deep understanding of the business, function and problem being transformed. Understand how the function operates today, including its workflows, users, decisions, systems, data sources, business rules, constraints and exceptions.
   

  

 You will be expected to learn unfamiliar domains quickly, identify what materially matters and distinguish the underlying problem from the initially stated requirement.
   

  

 1\.2 Solution Definition \& Product Design
   

  

 Own the translation of the business problem into a clear product solution.
   

  

 Define the scope, workflows, user experience, features, data requirements, integrations and product behavior. Determine where AI should play a role, where human judgment should remain, and how the solution should fit into the customer''''s broader operating environment.
   

  

 Prototyping is a core part of the role. You should be highly proficient at rapidly turning ideas into tangible product experiences that can be used to test thinking, explore workflows, communicate intent and drive alignment before and during development.
   

  

 You will own prioritization, feature planning, releases and the overall product roadmap for the deployment.
   

  

 1\.3 Product Judgment \& Advocacy
   

  

 Develop an independent, well\-reasoned point of view on what should be built and why.
   

  

 We expect our PMs to use first\-principles thinking rather than simply aggregate stakeholder requests. You should be able to challenge assumptions, evaluate alternatives, make trade\-offs and advocate convincingly for a direction with both customers and internal teams.
   

  

 This requires the confidence to hold a position when warranted and the judgment to change it when new evidence emerges.
   

  

 1\.4 Platform\-Led Solutioning
   

  

 Develop a deep understanding our enterprise AI platform and use it as the foundation for how you design solutions.
   

  

 You will need to understand its capabilities, architecture, product primitives, constraints and areas of extensibility. Job Description:
**Job title \- Principal, Services AI Solution Lead****Exp 10\-12 yrs** **Location \- Bangalore (Hybrid)****Job Purpose**  

Within the Digital Customer Relationship organization, you are responsible for defining how Artificial Intelligence can be leveraged within your capability scope to answer business needs while ensuring coherence, scalability, maintainability and alignment with enterprise standards.  

You act as the AI solution authority for your capability. You help translate validated business requirements into AI\-enabled solution options and formal recommendation papers, covering AI embedded in existing platforms, vendor capabilities, low\-code / pro\-code developments, autonomous agents and AI\-native platforms.  

Your mission is to ensure that the right AI solution pattern is selected and designed before delivery starts. You work closely with Business Product Leaders, Business Process Owners, E2E Business Architects, Digital Product Owners, Application Analysts, E2E Solution Design Leads, DCR Architects, Technical Leads, AI Hub, Data Office, platform owners and delivery teams.  

You do not replace the Business Product Leader, the Digital Product Owner, the E2E Solution Design Lead or the Technical Lead. You complement them by bringing AI\-specific architecture, assessment and design expertise into the existing Services Ways of Working.

* Support early discovery and handover discussions by clarifying AI opportunities, constraints, prerequisites and risks.
* Assess data readiness, process readiness, platform readiness and operational readiness before recommending an AI solution path.
* Challenge solution assumptions where AI is not the right answer, or where a simpler non\-AI solution could deliver sufficient business value.

**AI Solution Option Assessment*** Prepare structured AI assessment papers comparing the relevant solution options: embedded AI in existing platforms, vendor AI capability, low\-code AI, pro\-code AI, autonomous agents, AI\-native platforms and reuse of existing AI assets.

* Design AI interaction patterns, agent flows, human\-in\-the\-loop mechanisms, fallback scenarios, knowledge sources, data flows, integration points and monitoring requirements.

* Participate in the AI Architecture Board and other governance forums for complex, strategic or cross\-platform initiatives.
* Promote reuse of approved AI patterns, agent frameworks, connectors, data patterns, monitoring approaches and integration standards.

 **Delivery Support and Technical Decision Enablement*** Support Digital Product Owners, Application Analysts, E2E Solution Design Leads, Technical Leads and delivery teams during backlog definition, solution scoping and implementation preparation.
* Clarify AI architecture choices, constraints, prerequisites, dependencies and risks during delivery planning and execution.
* Support issue resolution when AI behavior, data dependencies, model outputs, integrations or agent flows create delivery or quality risks.

 **AI Run, Monitoring and Support Readiness*** Define AI\-specific run requirements before go\-live, including AI agent ownership, prompt / configuration ownership, knowledge source ownership, monitoring needs, escalation paths and support levels.
* Ensure AI agents and AI\-enabled solutions are designed with observability, traceability, quality monitoring, feedback loops and continuous improvement routines.
* Support transition to run by ensuring documentation, operating procedures, known limitations and ownership models are explicit and accepted.

The senior BA in the Health Plan Solutions team acts as a link between client business teams and NTT DATA’s technical staff. Design or review wireframes, screen mock\-ups, and UI behavior descriptions to ensure the user interface aligns with business workflows. Familiarity with using process flow tools or diagramming (Visio, Figma etc) to represent workflows.

Ability to work with user stories, acceptance criteria, backlogs, and sprints in tools like JIRA or Azure DevOps. Experience in an Application Services or consulting delivery model is preferred (working with global teams, handling enhancements/maintenance projects, etc.).

Contributing to the global risk oversight framework, supporting active management of all risks within Asset Management, establishing a suite of data\-driven analytics to monitor and respond to the changing risk profile of the global business, uplifting the communication and quality of support made available to the Chief Risk Officers of AM local entities, assisting with initiatives that mature the Second Line of Defence oversight framework for all risks affecting the Bangalore GSC, strengthening the risk culture across Bangalore GSC through the identification and sharing of risk management best practice, ensuring timely escalations and accurate records of incidents by the First Line of Defence, including root causes and progress towards remediation, ensuring a clear delineation of risk and control ownership exists between the service centre and global Risk Owners, Principal Accountabilities and Responsibilities (e.g., for Business, Customers and Stakeholders; internal control environment, etc.)

* Support global risk steward enquiries relating to the GSC.

**Product Owner**
**BASIC SUMMARY:**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and execution\-focused Product Owner to support the delivery of features and enhancements within our healthcare claims administration platform. This role is responsible for translating business and stakeholder needs into clear, actionable user stories and working closely with engineering teams to ensure timely , high\-quality delivery. * Write epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria that are clear, testable, and customer\-centric
* Conduct regular backlog grooming and sprint planning in collaboration with the Scrum team
* Participate in daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives as an active team member

**Requirements Gathering \& User Story Development**
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject matter experts, and internal teams to gather and refine product requirements
* Use AI tools (where applicable) to support the creation of epics, themes, and user stories

* Support refinement of use cases, workflows, and functional documentation


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**
* Serve as the primary point of contact for development teams during sprint execution
* Partner with UX/UI designers to ensure user stories are aligned with design principles and usability goals
* Support QA teams by clarifying acceptance criteria and reviewing test cases as needed
* Coordinate with other Product Owners to manage interdependencies between features


**Customer \& Stakeholder Engagement**
* Participate in stakeholder meetings to capture feature requests, enhancement ideas, and feedback
* Communicate updates to internal stakeholders on backlog priorities, delivery timelines, and sprint progress
* Help ensure features delivered meet customer needs and stakeholder expectations


**Healthcare Domain Support**
* Apply working knowledge of healthcare claims workflows, billing terminology, and reimbursement processes
* Support compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, HITECH) in collaboration with internal teams

**Minimum Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business , Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field

* Strong written and verbal communication skills for conveying requirements and feedback
* High attention to detail and organizational skills
* Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable working with cross\-functional teams and resolving blockers quickly


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or similar Agile certification

 As our AI ecosystem grows, this role will ensure the platform remains consistent, scalable and easy for product teams to build on. You'll own the platform capability roadmap and API contract, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering and the Platform Architect to prioritise platform investments, govern shared capabilities and prevent platform fragmentation.
   

  

 While the platform is currently internal, our long\-term vision is to evolve it into a customer\-facing platform where users can configure, orchestrate and interact with multiple AI agents. The decisions you make today will help shape that future.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Own the Platform
   

  

* Own the platform capability roadmap, defining what capabilities the platform exposes and how they evolve.
* Maintain and govern the platform API contract, ensuring it remains the single source of truth for APIs, event schemas and shared capabilities.
* Define platform standards that create a consistent experience across all AI agents.


 Drive Cross\-Team Alignment
   

  

* Partner with Product Owners across multiple AI squads to understand platform needs and prioritise shared capabilities.
* Consolidate similar requests into reusable platform solutions rather than one\-off features.
* Challenge requirements that could create inconsistency or unnecessary complexity across the platform.
* Identify emerging platform needs and proactively shape future capabilities.


 Collaborate Across the Business
   

  

* Work closely with the Platform Architect and Engineering Manager to balance product priorities with technical strategy.
* Communicate roadmap priorities, sequencing and platform decisions to stakeholders.

**What You'll Have**

* Proven experience managing product roadmaps and prioritising work across multiple teams.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical audiences.

 Bonus points for
